source: Kenya Revenue Authority, PAYE (https://www.kra.go.ke/individual/filing-paying/types-of-taxes/paye), read 2026-11-05; the page gives these bands as effective 1 July 2023. Annual: 10% on the first 288,000, 25% on the next 100,000, 30% on the next 5,612,000, 32.5% on the next 3,600,000, 35% above 9,600,000. Personal relief 2,400 a month (28,800 a year). The page lists as deductible from income, so take them off before passing taxable pay: Affordable Housing Levy, SHIF, post-retirement medical fund (15,000 a month), mortgage interest (30,000 a month) and registered pension or provident contributions (30,000 a month). Insurance relief is not modelled.

tests.name: monthly 50000: 117400 a year less 28800 relief, over 12
monthly 20000: relief wipes out the tax
monthly 24000: top of the first band
monthly 500000: top of the 30% band, 28800 + 25000 + 1683600 = 1737400 a year, less 28800 relief, over 12
monthly 1000000: reaches the 32.5% and 35% bands, 3747400 a year, less 28800 relief, over 12
